function.name: edit
function.description: Edit the contents of a file by finding and replacing exact text. When editing text from Read output, preserve the exact indentation (tabs or spaces) and omit the line-number prefix, such as `1: `. Never include the prefix in oldString or newString. Write line breaks as \n; the file's existing CRLF or LF line endings are matched and preserved. To change line endings themselves, make oldString and newString differ only in \r; that edit applies to the exact bytes. If there is no exact match, the edit retries while ignoring typographic quote, dash, and space variants, then trailing whitespace on each line. The edit fails if oldString is not found. By default, oldString must identify a UNIQUE location. Multiple matches FAIL unless replaceAll is true. Add more surrounding context to disambiguate, or set replaceAll to true to replace every occurrence. Use replaceAll when the change should apply to every occurrence, such as renaming a variable.

oldString.description: Exact text to find and replace

newString.description: Text to replace oldString with (must differ from oldString)

replaceAll.description: Whether to replace every occurrence of oldString. When false, oldString must match exactly once. Defaults to false.

function.name: glob
function.description: Search file paths using a glob pattern (examples: "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.tsx").

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files against

path.description: Directory to search. Defaults to the current working directory.

hidden.description: Include hidden files and directories (default: false).

limit.description: Maximum number of matching files to return (default: 100)

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents using ripgrep's regular expression syntax or literal text matching. Use it to locate specific code, symbols, or text patterns, and narrow searches with `path` or `include`. Returns matching file paths, line numbers, and line previews.

pattern.description: Regular expression or literal text to match in file contents.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the current working directory.

include.description: Glob pattern to filter files (for example, "*.js" or "*.{ts,tsx}")

literal.description: Treat `pattern` as exact text instead of a regular expression (default: false).

limit.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return (default: 100)

function.name: question
function.description:
Use this tool when you need to ask the user questions during execution. This allows you to:
1. Gather user preferences or requirements
2. Clarify ambiguous instructions
3. Get decisions on implementation choices as you work
4. Offer choices to the user about what direction to take.

Usage notes:
- A "Type your own answer" option is added automatically; don't include a separate option for free form answers
- Set `multiple: true` to allow selecting more than one option
- If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option in the list and add "(Recommended)" at the end of the label

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file or directory. Supports text files, images, and PDFs. Images and PDFs are presented directly to the model. Each text line is prefixed by its 1-based line number as <line>: <content>. The prefix is for reference and is not part of the file content. Directory entries are returned one per line. Use offset and limit to read large files or directories in sections. Prefer one larger read over many small slices, and use grep to find specific content in large files.

offset.description: The line or directory entry to start reading from (1-based)

limit.description: The maximum number of lines or directory entries to read (defaults to and capped at 2000)

function.name: shell
function.description: Execute a shell command and return its output. Commands run on Linux using bash. Quote file paths containing spaces or special characters. Prefer dedicated tools over shell commands when possible. When output is large, the full result is saved to a file and a truncated preview is returned. Rely on automatic truncation unless filtering the output is more useful. Commands accept an optional timeout, background commands have no timeout by default. Background commands return immediately, and you will be notified when they complete.

workdir.description: Working directory to execute the command in. Defaults to the current working directory. When possible, avoid changing directories in the command and set the working directory here instead.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable the timeout. Defaults to 120000 for foreground commands. Background commands have no timeout by default.

background.description: Run the command in the background and return immediately (useful for dev servers and long-running builds). You do not need to use '&' at the end of the command when using this parameter. You will be notified when it completes. DO NOT poll for completion.

function.name: skill
function.description:
Load a specialized skill's instructions and resources into the current conversation when the task at hand matches its description.

The skill ID must match an available skill or a skill explicitly referenced by the user.

id.description: The ID of an available skill or a skill explicitly referenced by the user

function.name: subagent
function.description:
Spawns an agent in a child session to work on the specified task.
The output includes a sessionID you can pass back later to continue that specific conversation with the subagent.
New child sessions start with fresh context, so include all relevant context and instructions when you don't pass a sessionID.
Foreground (default) runs the subagent to completion and returns its final response.
Background mode (background=true) launches it asynchronously and returns immediately; you are notified when it finishes.
Use background only for independent work that can run while you continue elsewhere.

Available subagents:
- explore: Fast agent specialized for exploring codebases. Use this when you need to quickly find files by patterns (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), search code for keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer questions about the codebase (eg. "how do API endpoints work?"). When calling this agent, specify the desired thoroughness level: "quick" for basic searches, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" for comprehensive analysis across multiple locations and naming conventions.
- general: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions and executing multi-step tasks. Use this agent to execute multiple units of work in parallel.

agent.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task. If the user asks for a subagent by a name that is not one of the available subagents, they most likely mean a model: pick a suitable agent and pass the name through the model parameter instead.

description.description: A short 3-5 word label for the task, displayed to the user

prompt.description: The task for the subagent to perform

model.description: NEVER set this unless the user explicitly asks for a particular model or variant. The value is written as "providerID/modelID", or "providerID/modelID#variant" to include a variant. Do not guess the ID: look the model up with the models tool, filtering to your own provider first.

sessionID.description: Continue a specific previous subagent conversation by passing its sessionID. Calls without a sessionID start a new conversation.

background.description: Run the subagent in the background and return immediately. You will be notified when it completes. DO NOT sleep, poll, or proactively check on its progress.

function.name: webfetch
function.description:
Fetch content from an HTTP or HTTPS URL and return it as text, markdown, or HTML. Markdown is the default.

Use a more targeted tool when one is available. This tool is read-only. Large text results may be replaced with a preview while the complete output is retained in managed storage.

url.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch content from

format.description: The format to return the content in. Defaults to markdown.

function.name: websearch
function.description:
Search the web using the user's selected search integration. Use this for current information beyond knowledge cutoff.

The current year is 2026. Use this year when searching for recent information or current events.

function.name: write
function.description:
Writes a file to the local filesystem, overwriting if one exists.

Missing parent directories are created automatically.

Use this tool to create new files or overwrite existing files. For partial changes, use the edit tool instead.

path.description: Path to the file to write to

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: execute
function.description:
Run JavaScript in a confined Code Mode runtime to script tool calls and HTTP requests and compose their results.
`fetch` is available for HTTP requests. Imports, direct filesystem access, and timers are unavailable; all other external access goes through `tools`.
Within `{ code }`, the only callable tools are those explicitly listed in the Code Mode catalog instructions or returned by the `search` function. Inside `{ code }`, ignore tools shown outside the Code Mode catalog. They are not available in the Code Mode runtime.
Call tools through `tools` using only exact paths and signatures from the catalog. Do not infer or normalize tool names; preserve bracket notation such as `tools.<namespace>["tool-name"](input)`.
Prefer an explicit `return`; if omitted, the final top-level expression becomes the result.
Await every call whose completion matters; pending calls are interrupted when execution ends. Run independent calls concurrently with `Promise.allSettled`.

function.name: chrome-devtools_click
function.description: Clicks on the provided element

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

dblClick.description: Set to true for double clicks. Default is false.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

function.name: chrome-devtools_close_page
function.description: Closes the page by its index. The last open page cannot be closed.

pageId.description: The ID of the page to close. Call list_pages to list pages.

function.name: chrome-devtools_drag
function.description: Drag an element onto another element

from_uid.description: The uid of the element to drag

to_uid.description: The uid of the element to drop into

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

function.name: chrome-devtools_emulate
function.description: Emulates various features on the selected page.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Omit to disable throttling.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Omit or set the rate to 1 to disable throttling

geolocation.description: Geolocation (`<latitude>,<longitude>`) to emulate. Latitude between -90 and 90. Longitude between -180 and 180. Omit to clear the geolocation override.

userAgent.description: User agent to emulate. Set to empty string to clear the user agent override.

colorScheme.description: Emulate the dark or the light mode. Set to "auto" to reset to the default.

viewport.description: Emulate device viewports '<width>x<height>x<devicePixelRatio>[,mobile][,touch][,landscape]'. 'touch' and 'mobile' to emulate mobile devices. 'landscape' to emulate landscape mode.

extraHttpHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers as a JSON string object, e.g. {"X-Custom": "value", "Authorization": "Bearer token"}. Headers are included into every HTTP request originating from the page and persist across navigations until cleared. Pass an empty string to clear all extra headers.

function.name: chrome-devtools_evaluate_script
function.description:
Evaluate a JavaScript function inside the currently selected page. Returns the response as JSON,
so returned values have to be JSON-serializable.

items.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

args.description: An optional list of arguments to pass to the function.

filePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a file to save the script output to. If omitted, the output is returned inline.

dialogAction.description: Handle dialogs while execution. "accept", "dismiss", or string for response of window.prompt. Defaults to accept.

function.name: chrome-devtools_fill
function.description: Type text into an input, text area or select an option from a <select> element.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

value.description: The value to fill in. "true" or "false" for checkboxes and toggles, "true" for radio buttons.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

function.name: chrome-devtools_fill_form
function.description: Fill out multiple form elements (inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios) at once. ALWAYS prefer this tool over multiple individual 'fill' or 'click' calls when interacting with forms. It is significantly faster, more reliable, and reduces turn count. Example: Fill username, password, and check "Remember Me" in one call.

uid.description: The uid of the element to fill out

value.description: Value for the element. "true" or "false" for checkboxes and toggles, "true" for radio buttons.

elements.description: Elements from snapshot to fill out.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

function.name: chrome-devtools_get_console_message
function.description: Gets a console message by its ID. You can get all messages by calling list_console_messages.

msgid.description: The msgid of a console message on the page from the listed console messages

function.name: chrome-devtools_get_network_request
function.description: Gets a network request by an optional reqid, if omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

reqid.description: The reqid of the network request. If omitted returns the currently selected request in the DevTools Network panel.

requestFilePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a .network-request file to save the request body to. If omitted, the body is returned inline.

responseFilePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a .network-response file to save the response body to. If omitted, the body is returned inline.

function.name: chrome-devtools_handle_dialog
function.description: If a browser dialog was opened, use this command to handle it

action.description: Whether to dismiss or accept the dialog

promptText.description: Optional prompt text to enter into the dialog.

function.name: chrome-devtools_hover
function.description: Hover over the provided element

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

function.name: chrome-devtools_lighthouse_audit
function.description: Get Lighthouse score and reports for accessibility, SEO, best practices, and agentic browsing. This excludes performance. For performance audits, run performance_start_trace

outputDirPath.description: Directory for reports. If omitted, uses temporary files.

function.name: chrome-devtools_list_console_messages
function.description: List all console messages for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, returns all messages.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

types.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all messages.

includePreservedMessages.description: Set to true to return the preserved messages over the last 3 navigations.

serviceWorkerId.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified service worker.

function.name: chrome-devtools_list_network_requests
function.description: List all requests for the currently selected page since the last navigation.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return. When omitted, returns all requests.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

resourceTypes.description: Filter requests to only return requests of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all requests.

includePreservedRequests.description: Set to true to return the preserved requests over the last 3 navigations.

function.name: chrome-devtools_list_pages
function.description: Get a list of pages open in the browser.

function.name: chrome-devtools_navigate_page
function.description: Go to a URL, or back, forward, or reload. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

type.description: Navigate the page by URL, back or forward in history, or reload.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore cache on reload.

handleBeforeUnload.description: Whether to auto accept or beforeunload dialogs triggered by this navigation. Default is accept.

initScript.description: A JavaScript script to be executed on each new document before any other scripts for the next navigation.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

function.name: chrome-devtools_new_page
function.description: Open a new tab and load a URL. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

background.description: Whether to open the page in the background without bringing it to the front. Default is false (foreground).

isolatedContext.description: If specified, the page is created in an isolated browser context with the given name. Pages in the same browser context share cookies and storage. Pages in different browser contexts are fully isolated.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

function.name: chrome-devtools_performance_analyze_insight
function.description: Provides more detailed information on a specific Performance Insight of an insight set that was highlighted in the results of a trace recording.

insightSetId.description: The id for the specific insight set. Only use the ids given in the "Available insight sets" list.

insightName.description: The name of the Insight you want more information on. For example: "DocumentLatency" or "LCPBreakdown"

function.name: chrome-devtools_performance_start_trace
function.description: Start a performance trace on the selected webpage. Use to find frontend performance issues, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), and improve page load speed.

reload.description: Determines if, once tracing has started, the current selected page should be automatically reloaded. Navigate the page to the right URL using the navigate_page tool BEFORE starting the trace if reload or autoStop is set to true.

autoStop.description: Determines if the trace recording should be automatically stopped.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

function.name: chrome-devtools_performance_stop_trace
function.description: Stop the active performance trace recording on the selected webpage.

filePath.description: The absolute file path, or a file path relative to the current working directory, to save the raw trace data. For example, trace.json.gz (compressed) or trace.json (uncompressed).

function.name: chrome-devtools_press_key
function.description: Press a key or key combination. Use this when other input methods like fill() cannot be used (e.g., keyboard shortcuts, navigation keys, or special key combinations).

key.description: A key or a combination (e.g., "Enter", "Control+A", "Control++", "Control+Shift+R"). Modifiers: Control, Shift, Alt, Meta

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

function.name: chrome-devtools_resize_page
function.description: Resizes the selected page's window so that the page has specified dimension

function.name: chrome-devtools_select_page
function.description: Select a page as a context for future tool calls.

pageId.description: The ID of the page to select. Call list_pages to get available pages.

bringToFront.description: Whether to focus the page and bring it to the top.

function.name: chrome-devtools_take_heapsnapshot
function.description: Capture a heap snapshot of the currently selected page. Use to analyze the memory distribution of JavaScript objects and debug memory leaks.

filePath.description: A path to a .heapsnapshot file to save the heapsnapshot to.

function.name: chrome-devtools_take_screenshot
function.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

format.description: Type of format to save the screenshot as. Default is "png"

quality.description: Compression quality for JPEG and WebP formats (0-100). Higher values mean better quality but larger file sizes. Ignored for PNG format.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot. If omitted, takes a page screenshot.

fullPage.description: If set to true takes a screenshot of the full page instead of the currently visible viewport. Incompatible with uid.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the screenshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

function.name: chrome-devtools_take_snapshot
function.description:
Take a text snapshot of the currently selected page based on the a11y tree. The snapshot lists page elements along with a unique
identifier (uid). Always use the latest snapshot. Prefer taking a snapshot over taking a screenshot. The snapshot indicates the element selected
in the DevTools Elements panel (if any).

verbose.description: Whether to include all possible information available in the full a11y tree. Default is false.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the snapshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

function.name: chrome-devtools_type_text
function.description: Type text using keyboard into a previously focused input

submitKey.description: Optional key to press after typing. E.g., "Enter", "Tab", "Escape"

function.name: chrome-devtools_upload_file
function.description: Upload a file through a provided element.

uid.description: The uid of the file input element or an element that will open file chooser on the page from the page content snapshot

filePath.description: The local path of the file to upload

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

function.name: chrome-devtools_wait_for
function.description: Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page.

text.description: Non-empty list of texts. Resolves when any value appears on the page.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.
